value.rationale: The size enumerator recognizes every peripheral clique size (constructive isomorphism recovery) on a natural unbounded block-graph family, whereas prior friendship counts and scalar zero-forcing values cannot do so. Its accompanying heterogeneous Poisson/Rayleigh limit is directly motivated by random-set forcing thresholds and quantifies a natural independent pair-obstruction mechanism under a sharp maximum-size condition. This is more than an arbitrary extra coefficient or routine parameter substitution; the already-known homogeneous friendship special case is acknowledged.
